founder.title: Hello, I'm Adel, CEO & Teacher at Rēkāz
founder.bio: I want you to know that our mission is bigger than teaching subjects — it's about helping you believe in yourself, discover your potential, and achieve your dreams. Every lesson we give is designed with your future in mind, because I believe each of you has the ability to succeed and make a difference. Rēkāz is more than a school; it's a place where together we build the confidence, knowledge, and ambition that will carry you forward in life.

aboutPreview.text: At Rēkāz, we believe education is more than lessons — it is the foundation for building confident, ambitious, and successful lives. From the early years of CEM to the challenges of BEM and BAC, our mission is to guide every student with care, innovation, and passion. Rēkāz is not just a school, but a home where dreams are nurtured, values are strengthened, and futures are shaped.

faq.title: Questions about Rēkāz? We're here to help.

items.q: Which school levels does Rēkāz support?
items.a: We support all CEM (Middle School) levels from 1CEM to 4CEM/BEM, and all Lycée (High School) levels from 1AS to 3AS/BAC.
Yes, we provide comprehensive support across all subjects required for both middle school and high school curriculums.

items.q: What is included in BEM and BAC preparation?
items.a: Our preparation includes intensive subject review, past paper practice, mock exams, and strategic guidance to build confidence.
We offer practical courses in entrepreneurship, marketing, digital skills, cybersecurity, and advanced management.
Yes, all our professional formations conclude with a valid certificate upon successful completion.
Our modern E-Learning platform is launching soon, allowing you to learn anything, anywhere, anytime.

aboutPage.metaDesc: Learn about Rēkāz Establishment, our mission, vision, and our founder Adel.

aboutPage.visionDesc: To become one of the most recognized educational institutions in Béchar and expand across Algeria, setting a standard for modern and effective learning methodologies.
aboutPage.founderQuote: "I want you to know that our mission is bigger than teaching subjects — it's about helping you believe in yourself, discover your potential, and achieve your dreams."
aboutPage.founderDesc: As an educator and leader, Adel brings his passion for teaching and his vision for a better educational framework to every student that walks through the doors of Rēkāz Establishment.
aboutPage.pillar1Desc: Providing top-tier educational support for all levels to ensure outstanding academic results.
aboutPage.pillar2Desc: Equipping learners with real-world skills through practical, industry-relevant formations.
aboutPage.pillar3Desc: Expert guidance for students and businesses to make informed and strategic decisions.
aboutPage.pillar4Desc: Pioneering digital education platforms to make learning accessible anywhere, anytime.

consultationPage.heroDesc: Whether you're a student deciding your academic future or a business owner looking for growth strategies, our expert consultants are here to guide you every step of the way.
consultationPage.eduDesc: Helping students and families make informed academic decisions. We analyze strengths, weaknesses, and interests to recommend the best educational paths and study methodologies.
consultationPage.careerDesc: Guiding high school graduates and professionals toward the right university majors or career transitions. We map out actionable plans for long-term professional success.
consultationPage.bizDesc: Providing comprehensive strategies in digital marketing, cybersecurity, and management to help local businesses optimize their operations and scale effectively.
consultationPage.methodDesc: We don't just offer advice and leave. We believe in continuous partnership. Our holistic approach ensures that your business doesn't just adapt to the market, but thrives in it.
